d:
The Heat defeated the Jazz, 115-109 tonight in Utah. Giannis Antetokounmpo contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 11 rebounds and 4 assists, with Davion Mitchell of the Heat adding an additional 19 points (5-13 FG, 3-7 3P) in the game. Darryn Peterson finished with a team-high 25 points along with 4 rebounds for the Jazz in the losing effort. The Heat improve their record to 5-6 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-10 for the season.
